IncidentBot: P1 pager - spike in 503s (ingest-proxy) in ap-southeast-1. Auto-mitigation failed twice. Pager: pager-9876

Mia: I'm on handoff now (15:00->23:00). @Carlos are you available for comms? Need a driver + comms assignment.

Carlos: I can take comms. I'll post updates and handle status page. Mia, you want to drive the mitigation?

Mia: yes, I'll drive. Running through runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ingest-proxy-503. Initial triage: check ingress LB health and backend pool saturation.

Lee: FYI I see a sudden increase in retry loops from our analytics partner. Could be bad client. Also seeing memory pressure on pod-4.

Mia: running commands:
```bash
kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=ingest-proxy -o wide
kubectl -n infra exec -it pod/ingest-proxy-4 -- curl -sS localhost:8080/health
```
Pods 2/5 report 503s; pod-4 OOMKilled in last 5m.

Noor: I'll prep a temporary autoscale bump for the deployment and adjust HPA min to 5 -> 8. ETA 3m. Also suggest edge rate-limit for suspected misbehaving clients.

Carlos: Posted initial comm: "Elevated 503 errors in ap-southeast-1 affecting ingestion. Mitigations in progress. Customers may experience delayed ingestion. More updates in 10m." :loudspeaker: 

Mia: initiating pod recycle for pod-4, and spinning extra replicas. If OOM persists, we'll roll back recent config drift (memory limit lowered yesterday). Check config diff: `kubectl -n infra describe deployment ingest-proxy | grep -A3 resources`.

IncidentBot: Incident annotated: severity=P1, driver=Mia, comms=Carlos, secondary=Lee, runbook=https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ingest-proxy-503, started=2987654321

Noor: autoscaler adjusted. New replicas spinning up. Edge rate-limit applied for suspect client IP block. Watching error rate.

Carlos: Next comm update: "Autoscaling and pod recovery in progress; applying temporary edge limits. Expected partial recovery within ~8-12 minutes." :memo: 

Mia: handoff note for incoming shift: driving state - pod-level OOM suspected (recent memory limit change), autoscale and edge limits applied. Carlos on comms, Lee on telemetry and logs. If error rate >2% after 15m, escalate to Dedicated failover. I'll create an incidents channel PM for post-mortem owner.

Lee: I'll collect flamegraphs and heap dumps for pod-4 and attach to the incident ticket.

Carlos: I'll keep posting every 10m or on change. Tagging @oncall-next for takeover. :bell: 

Mia: thanks team. handing over to night shift in 30m; will update channel with final status before leaving."
